skillTree.localised_description: A Bellower’s voice is as deep as it loud, carrying across the battlefield and encouraging unbridled carnage.

These Gnoblars have gone mad, immersed in blood, they have become unable to control themselves and attack on sight anything that moves in their field of vision, chained to Fernadrang they are like hounds protecting their master.
Each victory reinvigorates Khorne's champions to seek more bloodshed.

skillTree.localised_description: The followers of Chaos need not to rest, they march on with iron hearts desperate to harvest souls.
This Lord speaks with a dread booming voice - a gift from his Dark Masters to ensure obedience.
At times, this servant of Khorne storms across the battlefield with arrows lodged in his chest. However, they seem to do little but further stoke the raging fire of his wrath.
Few magics can worm their way through this one's skull; their Khornate collar offers adequate protection, as does the impenetrable, relentless fury infecting his mind.
Having learned much in their long years of service, this character now turns their attention to training others.

skillTree.localised_description: The Warriors of Chaos are the playthings of Gods and given many gifts, including formidable fighting skills.
Some creatures charge home with such fury that the very ground shakes beneath their feet.
Hand-to-hand combat is a lethal match of cut and thrust. However, it’s not all about offensive strikes; parries and other defensive moves can also win the day.
A truly sturdy armour is needed to hold such an overflowing gut in place.
Such is their power and ferocity, a wound-maker will ravage the foe, cutting and pulverising until there is only one exit - death.
If the enormous size of this Ogre doesn't incite terror, his bloody, malevolent smile surely will.

skillTree.localised_description: This Ogre's greed shall never be sated, for his stomach is as endless as his hunger.
No enemy is immovable when in the path of a furious Ogre's charge.
A deadly blade is especially lethal when in the hands of this master death-maker, killer and slaughterer!
A Chaos Lord dominates – lesser beings cringe from a being that is so intently under scrutiny from the Dark Gods.

backgroundSkills.localised_description: The Blood God Khorne whispered into the ears of his followers, and they slid into the ancient Reman Empire's heart like a stiletto. They brought false advice, illicit witness, assassination, corruption and conceit to the government of Remas. Their foul Chaos Cults spread upon the land, displacing those Powers of Heart and Sky who had served the simple people for centuries. Finally, Khorne spoke again, and there was war. The chosen one which will lead the Blood God's armies during the invasion was Fernadrang, a misshapen and corrupted Chaos Ogre.
